title: 第18章震惊四座

第18章震惊四座-《穿越60带着空间当保安》

见没有人再进入，大门的栏杆放了下来。王野和赵爷爷就去吴志强的办公室了。老远就看见吴志强已经集合好队伍正在训话。吴志强看见王野到了对他摆摆手，王野紧走两步站在吴志强身边。

吴志强大声的说：“今天给大家介绍一下，他叫王野，以后和咱们就是一个战壕的兄...嗯…同志了。”

吴志强刚要说兄弟觉得不对，赶紧改口说是同志，然后说：“王野说他枪法不错，这是骡子是马得拉出来溜溜。正好咱们也有段时间没打靶了，每人五发子弹，领取装备，出发靶场！”

吴志强带着王野去库房，挑了一把崭新的三八大盖，又给了他30发子弹，一行人集合去了靶场。靶场就在厂子边上的空地上。

吴志强小声的对王野说：“小子，现在后悔还来的及。”

王野白了一眼吴志强：“师父，你前面吹牛的时候，咋没想到我会不会后悔呀，你都说了我枪法不错，我这么懂事儿的徒弟，还能让你的话打水漂呀”。

吴志强大声宣布：“王野先来，让我们看看，大家呱唧呱唧！”

一阵掌声后，王野上前两步，一看靶子50米。王野举枪射击，连瞄准动作都没有，一众人先是愣了一下，然后哄堂大笑。

吴志强老脸一红：“王野就是走火了，咱不要笑啊！”

王野对着吴志强大声说：“科长，我没有走火，你可以派人报靶了！”

吴志强看着王野坚定的目光，将信将疑的指着一个人说：“那个谁，你去取靶纸。”

一个岁数不大的小伙子，小跑着取回靶纸，众人一看正中心十环，都很吃惊，对于保卫科来说，50米十环已经很不错了。

王野并不满足：“科长，我要打200米。”

吴志强只好命人摆了一个200米的靶子，见摆靶子的人回来，王野举枪射击，拉栓继续，一连四枪，打完收工。吴志强看王野就像看怪物一样，挥了挥手让人把靶纸取回来，四枪40环，这回众人倒吸口凉气，这枪法就算在部队都是神枪手了。

王野看了看吴志强，又看看不远处的赵爷爷，好像是说“怎么样？不错吧！”

赵爷爷点了点头转身走了。一个小时左右打靶结束，各队都去各自的工作岗位了。

王野回到门房，赵爷爷喝着茶水对王野说：“你小子还真是个怪才，要不去当兵吧，肯定有出息！”

王野兴致缺缺：“赵爷爷，我现在工作挺好的，而且现在是和平年代了，自从咱们在半岛上打了漂亮国，短期内不会有大战了，没战争想立功太难了。我还是好好上我的班，给你、我爷爷奶奶、太爷爷养老才是正事儿。”

赵爷爷也没坚持，随口问：“会骑自行车吗？”

“会呀，怎么了？”

“你去你师父那里骑自行车，回趟你爷爷家，把那套虎骨拿回来，我让你师父去买辅药，今天晚上就开始泡药浴，你年龄毕竟到了，不能再耽误时间。”

王野答应一声就出门了，赵爷爷在后面喊：“叫吴志强过来！”

王野边走边答应，来到吴志强的办公室，推门就进，看里没人直接说：“师父，赵爷爷叫你过去，还让我骑你的自行车出去办点事儿。”

吴志强出门指着门口的自行车：“会骑吗？”

王野也不答话，骑上自行车就走。

吴志强赶紧跟上，边走边喊：“你慢点儿，我那是新车！”

王野才不回话呢，骑到门口，也不下车，对着门卫喊了声：“赵爷爷，我先走了啊！”

Seeing that no one was entering again, the railing of the gate was lowered.Wang Ye and Grandpa Zhao went to Wu Zhiqiang's office.From afar, he saw that Wu Zhiqiang had assembled his team and was giving a lecture.Wu Zhiqiang saw Wang Ye arriving and waved to him. Wang Ye took two steps and stood next to Wu Zhiqiang.

Wu Zhiqiang said loudly: "Let me introduce you today. His name is Wang Ye. From now on, we will be brothers in the trenches... um... comrades."

Wu Zhiqiang was about to say that his brother felt something was wrong, but he quickly changed his words and said that he was a comrade, and then said: "Wang Ye said that his marksmanship is good, and he has to be pulled around like a mule or a horse. It just so happens that we haven't practiced shooting for a while. Each of us has five rounds of ammunition, collect the equipment, and set off to the shooting range!"

Wu Zhiqiang took Wang Ye to the warehouse, picked out a brand new Sanba Gai, and gave him 30 rounds of bullets. The group gathered and went to the shooting range.The shooting range is in the open space next to the factory.

Wu Zhiqiang whispered to Wang Ye: "Boy, it's not too late to regret now."

Wang Ye rolled his eyes at Wu Zhiqiang: "Master, when you were bragging earlier, you never thought that I would regret it. You already said that my shooting skills are good. I am such a sensible apprentice, but I can still make your words go in vain."

Wu Zhiqiang announced loudly: "Wang Ye is here first, let us take a look, everyone is chirping!"

After a burst of applause, Wang Ye took two steps forward and looked at the target 50 meters away.Wang Ye raised his gun and fired without even aiming. Everyone was stunned for a moment, and then burst into laughter.

Wu Zhiqiang's old face turned red: "Wang Ye just lost his temper, let's not laugh!"

Wang Ye said loudly to Wu Zhiqiang: "Section Chief, I didn't misfire. You can send someone to report the target!"

Wu Zhiqiang looked at Wang Ye's firm eyes, pointed at someone suspiciously and said, "Who is that? Go get the target paper."

A young man trotted back to retrieve the target paper. Everyone was surprised when they saw the ten rings in the center. For the security department, the 50-meter ten rings was already pretty good.

Wang Ye was not satisfied: "Section chief, I want to run 200 meters."

Wu Zhiqiang had no choice but to order someone to set up a 200-meter target. When the man who set the target came back, Wang Ye raised his gun and fired, pulled the bolt and continued, shooting four times in a row, and then called it a day.Wu Zhiqiang looked at Wang Ye as if he were a monster. He waved his hand and asked someone to take back the target paper. Four shots and 40 rings. This time everyone took a breath. This marksmanship was even considered a sharpshooter in the army.

Wang Ye looked at Wu Zhiqiang, then at Grandpa Zhao not far away, as if to say, "How is it? Not bad!"

Grandpa Zhao nodded and turned away.The target practice ended in about an hour, and each team went to their respective stations.

Wang Ye returned to the concierge. Grandpa Zhao drank tea and said to Wang Ye: "You are really a geek. Why don't you become a soldier? You will definitely have a future!"

Wang Ye was in a lack of interest: "Grandpa Zhao, I'm doing a good job now, and it's a peaceful era. Since we fought against the beautiful country on the peninsula, there won't be a war in the short term. It would be too difficult to make contributions without a war. I'd better go to my job and take care of you, my grandparents, and my great-grandfather in their old age."

Grandpa Zhao didn't insist and asked casually: "Can you ride a bicycle?"

"Yes, what's wrong?"

"You go to your master's place to ride a bicycle, go back to your grandfather's house, and bring back the set of tiger bones. I will ask your master to buy auxiliary medicines and start taking medicinal baths tonight. You are old after all, so you can't waste any more time."

Wang Ye agreed and went out. Grandpa Zhao shouted from behind: "Call Wu Zhiqiang over!"

Wang Ye agreed as he walked. When he came to Wu Zhiqiang's office, he opened the door and entered. Seeing no one there, he said directly: "Master, Grandpa Zhao asked you to come over and asked me to ride your bicycle out to do some errands."

Wu Zhiqiang went out and pointed to the bicycle at the door: "Can you ride it?"

Wang Ye didn't answer, got on his bicycle and left.

Wu Zhiqiang quickly followed, shouting as he walked: "Slow down, my car is new!"

Wang Ye didn't reply. He rode to the door and didn't get off the car. He shouted to the guard: "Grandpa Zhao, I'm leaving first!"
